test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

She said to them, “Stick out your hands over your brooms.”

options.text: She asked them if they stuck their hands out over their brooms.
She told them that they should stick out their hands over her brooms.
She told them they should stick out your hands over their brooms.
She asked them to stick out their hands over their brooms.

solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'She asked them to stick out their hands over their brooms..'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The given sentence is an imperative sentence.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'to' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• In the Indirect speech 'said to' will be changed into 'asked' because reporting verb has an object, **'them.'**
 
• The indirect speech will begin like 'She asked them.'
 
• Now we have to change the reported speech.
 
• Here 'your' is used twice and will be changed into 'their' twice.
 
• According to the rules of grammar, after **'to'** the verb will be in the present form **'stick.'**
 
• Finally, the indirect speech is 'She asked them to stick out their hands over their brooms.'
 
• ​So, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *She asked them to stick out their hands over their brooms.*
